base: Use case: stylized-concept, new character design in an established game's art direction. The references are ONLY a style guide for fine dark ink contours, mature anime facial rendering, soft cel-painted shadows, neutral skin undertones, and ivory/blue-gray Chinese paper texture. Invent a completely different person's anatomy described below; never copy a reference face, eye shape, nose or jaw. No generic handsome Song Jiang face. No pixelation or photorealism. OUTPUT: a regular seamless 3-column by 2-row atlas, landscape 9:7; six equal 6:7 head-and-shoulder portraits, no gutters, borders, lettering. Same identity, pose, costume, framing and lighting across the six cells; change facial expression only. Reading order NORMAL (personality-specific), ANGRY, SAD, SMILE, SHOCK, CONCERNED. Clear facial acting readable at 144x168. Full head and hair with safe margins inside each cell, upper torso at bottom, paper-only backdrop. All characters Chinese, Song dynasty clothing.
